decision: Selected the planar centroid of Clayton County tax parcel 12236B A001 (4350 E Tanners Church Rd, Ellenwood; 34.683 acres) as the project locator for the EPD-listed facility "TADG - ATL02 / Ellenwood".
layer: Clayton County GIS "Clayton_GIS_SD_TAXPARCELS" FeatureServer layer 0 on the Clayton County ArcGIS Online organisation (services5.arcgis.com/m528W8U8YDYeMPrQ); native spatial reference WGS84 (EPSG:4326); layer data last edited 7 March 2024.

12236B A001.owner_attribute: ANVIL BLOCK LAND PARTNERS III LLC (sale date 29 December 2021 in a layer last edited March 2024; not asserted as the current owner)

identity_bridge: Georgia EPD public advisory PA0926-4 lists, for Clayton County, Facility Name "TADG - ATL02 / Ellenwood", Application No. 30104, Facility Address 4350 E Tanners Church Road, Ellenwood, 30294, Proposed Permit to "Construct and operate an advanced technology ecosystem data center".

Clayton County's Zoning Projects layer record BOC-2408-0439, "TA Realty - Ellenwood Data Center" (status Approved, application date 2 August 2024), describes a request by TA Realty for approval of a site plan, height increase and modifications for a proposed data center at 4350 E Tanners Church Rd in the Ellenwood PUD-MU/Data Center district, "±34.68 acres, is further known as Parcel 12236B A001"; its mapped point lies inside the parcel, 57 m from the selected point.

TA Digital Group's Georgia portfolio page lists ATL02 as a 35-acre, one-building, 725,000 sq ft project in Clayton County, Ellenwood, GA, tying the TADG/ATL02 permit name to TA Realty's digital-infrastructure arm.
The Clayton tax-parcel layer has exactly one parcel at 4350 E Tanners Church Rd (12236B A001).
unresolved: The building footprint, substation position and any construction area within the parcel are not published; the point locates the 34.7-acre property, not the planned building.
The tax-parcel layer was last edited in March 2024, so its owner field may predate any later conveyance; ownership is not used for identity.

computed.method: Planar centroid of the Clayton County tax-parcel polygon (layer native spatial reference WGS84, EPSG:4326, so no coordinate transformation is involved); geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid.
